description: Known failure patterns and their fixes for the Self-Improving Agent Architect

failure_patterns.pattern: Agent mentions 'I don't have enough context'

fix.description: Add more context to agent prompt about project structure and goals
suggestions: Include explicit project directory structure
Add examples of expected output format
Specify the tech stack being used
Provide context about related files

fix.description: Split agent responsibilities into multiple smaller agents
suggestions: Break the task into 2-3 smaller sub-tasks
Create dependency chain between new agents
Reduce scope of individual agent prompts

failure_patterns.pattern: Type error: property X does not exist

fix.description: Update shared interface contract between agents
suggestions: Add explicit TypeScript interface definitions to shared/types.ts
Include interface contracts in agent prompts
Ensure all agents reference the same type definitions

failure_patterns.pattern: Cannot find module or import failed
failure_patterns.regex: (?i)(cannot find module|import.*failed|module not found|no such file)

fix.description: Ensure dependency agent runs before this agent
suggestions: Check wave ordering in swarm design
Add explicit dependency in agent prompt
Create the missing file in an earlier wave

fix.description: Break the circular dependency by restructuring
suggestions: Extract shared code into a separate utility module
Use dependency injection instead of direct imports
Create an interface module that both can import

fix.description: Reduce parallel execution and add delays
suggestions: Reduce max_concurrent agents
Increase launch_stagger delay
Implement exponential backoff

failure_patterns.pattern: Out of memory or context length exceeded

fix.description: Reduce agent scope or split into multiple agents
suggestions: Split large file generation into multiple agents
Reduce context passed to agent
Use streaming or chunked processing

failure_patterns.pattern: Multiple agents wrote same file differently

fix.description: Clarify file ownership in agent prompts
suggestions: Explicitly assign files to specific agents
Use different file names or directories
Define clear boundaries in agent responsibilities

failure_patterns.pattern: TODO or placeholder left in code

fix.description: Add explicit completeness requirement to prompt
suggestions: Add 'Do not leave any TODOs or placeholders' to success criteria
Include 'All functions must be fully implemented' requirement
Reduce scope if implementation is too complex

fix.description: Add build verification step to integration agent
suggestions: Include 'Verify code compiles without errors' in success criteria
Add syntax validation before marking complete
Include specific build commands in agent prompt

fix.description: Ensure test requirements are clear and tests are run
suggestions: Add 'All tests must pass' to success criteria
Include test running instructions in QA agent prompt
Specify expected test coverage

failure_patterns.pattern: API interface doesn't match expected contract

fix.description: Strengthen interface contracts in agent prompts
suggestions: Include exact API signatures in prompts
Add TypeScript interfaces to shared resources
Create interface validation step

failure_patterns.pattern: Agent unclear about what to do

fix.description: Add explicit task list to agent prompt
suggestions: List specific files to create
Define exact functions to implement
Include concrete success criteria
Review and clarify requirements before swarm launch
Prioritize requirements if they conflict
Split conflicting requirements to different agents

fix.description: Explicitly specify tech stack in agent prompts
suggestions: List required frameworks and versions
Include 'Do not use [X]' constraints
Add tech stack to shared configuration

success_patterns.description: Prompts with explicit file lists have 85% higher success rate
success_patterns.recommendation: Always include a 'Files to Create' section with specific filenames

success_patterns.description: Prompts with TypeScript interfaces reduce type errors by 90%
success_patterns.recommendation: Define shared types in shared/types.ts and reference in prompts

success_patterns.description: Prompts with measurable success criteria complete 40% faster
Explicit dependency declarations reduce integration conflicts by 75%
success_patterns.recommendation: Always specify what the agent needs from and provides to others

success_patterns.description: Including example outputs improves quality scores by 30%
success_patterns.recommendation: Add code examples or sample outputs to complex prompts

mutation_templates.description: Add explicit file list to prompt
Replace vague language with specific instructions

patterns.to: wrap in try-catch blocks and log errors to console
